_instructions: Copy only keys beginning with -- into Glue job parameters. Replace uppercase placeholders. The _instructions and _parameter_help fields are documentation, not job arguments.

_parameter_help.GENERATION: Durable query/checkpoint identity. Keep it on restart; allocate a new one for a new replay selection.
_parameter_help.PROCESSING_VERSION: Business result version included in the fact key. Keep reports scoped to one version.
_parameter_help.RUN_MODE: live reads Kinesis continuously; replay reads a bounded S3 selection once.
_parameter_help.REPLAY_PREFIX: Raw S3 arrival-time prefix. Keep it stable for one replay generation; use unused in live mode.
_parameter_help.REPLAY_FROM / REPLAY_TO: Inclusive start and exclusive end in business event time; use unused in live mode.
_parameter_help.FAIL_AFTER_COMMIT_BATCH: -1 disables injection; any or a batch number fails after commit but before checkpoint completion.
_parameter_help.COPY_ROLE_ARN: Namespace-associated IAM role allowing Redshift to read the completed S3 staging files.
_parameter_help.conf: Disable speculative Spark tasks to avoid unnecessary duplicate work.
_parameter_help.additional-python-modules: Pinned SDK versions supporting conditional S3 object creation.
